# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus v0.6.8

**Online leaderboards.** Turn them on in the launcher, pick a name, and your best runs go up against everyone else playing PC Plus. This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## What's new

- **Online leaderboards.** On the launcher's **Gameplay** page, switch **Online leaderboards** on and choose a **Player name** (up to 15 letters, digits, spaces, `_ . -`). Each finished run's score is sent to the PC Plus leaderboard server, and the game's own **Everyone** boards show the top players from it, with your row highlighted. If the server can't be reached, the game quietly uses your local boards, exactly as before.
- **Your name in the game.** With a player name set, the game shows it instead of "User": in the menus, on your leaderboard rows and on the personal best while you play.
- **Keyboard controls are on from the start.** The launcher's Keyboard setting showed On while the game kept the keyboard off until it was changed; they now agree.

## Online leaderboards: what's sent

Only with the setting on: your player name, your scores, what you played with (mouse, keyboard or controller) and the game version. Runs with cheats on are never sent. No account, email or IP address is kept. **Delete my online scores** on the Gameplay page removes your name and every score you've sent. Scores come from players' own PCs, so these are community boards for fun, not a tournament.

Online leaderboards are Windows only for now; the Linux build keeps the local boards.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v0.6.8-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating from v0.6.7: extract over it, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
